title: Canon a 4

captions.text: ☞ Bach wrote one line in two clefs; the flute begins it alone.
☞ The cello: the same line two octaves lower, seven bars later.
☞ The violin: the flute's line at the same pitch, fourteen bars later.
☞ The harpsichord: two octaves below the flute, like the cello.
☞ Perpetual: the flute is back at its first note; the line goes round.
☞ The third time round every voice holds its note: an editorial end.

listenFor: one line, four voices: canon at the unison and two octaves apart

glossaryNotes.canon-at-the-unison: Four voices, one line: the two trebles sing it at the same pitch, the two basses two octaves lower; the four entries come seven bars apart.
